description: CMS / PAdES signature in ONE call: a missing /Sig placeholder is auto-injected (prepare_signature_placeholder is optional). Inputs: pdfBase64, algorithm (rsa-sha256/384/512, ecdsa-sha256 P-256), certDerBase64 (+ certChainDerBase64 intermediates) and the DER key (rsaKeyPkcs1DerBase64 for rsa-*, ecPrivateKeyDerBase64 or ecPrivateScalarHex for ECDSA; PEM is rejected with the openssl remedy). `profile:'pades'` (ETSI EN 319 142-1 baseline) is the right choice when add_ltv / timestamp_pdf follow; `timestamp:true` = PAdES B-T through the operator TSA (TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED otherwise, no network without it). signerName/reason/location/contactInfo/signingTime are baked into the placeholder THIS call injects (a pre-built placeholder keeps its own). Several unsigned placeholders → pass fieldName (PLACEHOLDER_AMBIGUOUS); `allowMultiple:true` + a new fieldName adds a further signature. Verify with verify_pdf.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. 'rsa-sha384' / 'rsa-sha512' (pdfnative 1.7) upgrade the whole CMS digest chain. ECDSA only supports P-256 with SHA-256.

allowMultiple.description: Add a NEW signature next to existing (already signed) fields instead of signing the first placeholder. Requires fieldName. Each signature is an incremental revision; earlier signatures stay valid.

autoInjectPlaceholder.description: When true (default) and the input PDF has no /Sig widget, pdfnative.addSignaturePlaceholder is called before signing — enabling single-call signing of any PDF.

certChainDerBase64.description: Optional intermediate CA certificates (DER base64) embedded in the CMS so verifiers and add_ltv can build the chain without fetching caIssuers.

certDerBase64.description: Base64 of the signer X.509 certificate in DER form. Convert from PEM with: openssl x509 -in cert.pem -outform DER | openssl base64 -A

contactInfo.description: /Sig /ContactInfo — baked into the placeholder when this call injects it.

ecPrivateKeyDerBase64.description: Base64 of an ECDSA P-256 private key in SEC1 (RFC 5915) or PKCS#8 (RFC 5208) DER form. Convert from PEM with: openssl pkey -in key.pem -outform DER | openssl base64 -A  Mutually exclusive with ecPrivateScalarHex.

ecPrivateScalarHex.description: Hex-encoded P-256 private scalar `d` (exactly 64 lowercase or uppercase hex chars, no 0x prefix). Mutually exclusive with ecPrivateKeyDerBase64; either is accepted for ECDSA.

fieldName.description: Name of the signature field to sign (required when several unsigned placeholders exist) and of the placeholder injected by this call.

location.description: /Sig /Location — baked into the placeholder when this call injects it.

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default) returns the PDF inline; 'file' writes it inside the PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (SECURITY_VIOLATION when the sandbox is not configured).

outputPath.description: Required when outputMode='file'. Relative path inside the sandbox; must end with .pdf (no absolute paths, no '..').

pdfBase64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes. When the PDF already contains an unsigned /Sig placeholder it is signed in place; otherwise the placeholder is auto-injected (set autoInjectPlaceholder=false to opt out).

profile.description: 'pkcs7' (default, adbe.pkcs7.detached) or 'pades' (ETSI EN 319 142-1 baseline; ETSI.CAdES.detached when the placeholder is injected here). Use 'pades' before timestamp / add_ltv / timestamp_pdf.

reason.description: /Sig /Reason — baked into the placeholder when this call injects it.

rsaKeyPkcs1DerBase64.description: Base64 of the RSA private key in DER form — PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey (openssl rsa -in key.pem -outform DER -traditional | openssl base64 -A) or PKCS#8 PrivateKeyInfo (openssl pkey -in key.pem -outform DER | openssl base64 -A). NOT PEM. Required for the rsa-* algorithms.

signerName.description: /Sig /Name — baked into the placeholder when this call injects it.

signingTime.description: ISO-8601 signing instant → /Sig /M (only when THIS call injects the placeholder) and the CMS signing-time (pkcs7 profile). Default: now. Not trusted time — use timestamp:true for that.

timestamp.description: PAdES B-T: request an RFC 3161 signature timestamp from the operator-configured TSA (PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL). Fails with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED when no TSA is configured — the server never contacts the network otherwise.

name: sign_pdf

outputSchema.description: Result of a PDF-producing tool. base64 mode: the PDF arrives as an embedded `resource` content block (not duplicated here); file mode: `filePath`.

title: Sign PDF (RSA / ECDSA, PAdES)
